answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock blocks fake identities. Each agent locks $25 in a vault and must finish 20 verified jobs over 10 epochs; identical patterns flag one operator behind many names. A bridge of trust forms only after those jobs pass, with one verified history per payout. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 20,000 fake jobs, and the tide of fakes stalls at the vault door. An honest agent pays $25 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
